title: AEZ-26 High Barind Tract historical flash-drought analysis: code (v1.0.1)
description: Google Earth Engine scripts, original Colab notebooks (Phases 2A, 2C–2G and 7A), Python code and documentation supporting the manuscript on historical flash drought in the High Barind Tract (Agro-Ecological Zone 26), Bangladesh: event detection and chronology comparison between GLDAS-2.1 and ERA5-Land, ERA5-Land soil-water storage (Eq. 6) and temperature, dew-point, VPD and relative-humidity calculations (Eq. 7), driver diagnostics, land–water response analysis, FDR-controlled association tests, seasonal-control and consensus-event analyses. The release is not an end-to-end raw-to-result reproduction: Phases 2A, 2E and 2F cannot be fully reproduced because source extracts, the merge workflow and quality-control inputs are not redistributed; third-party raw datasets and the study-area polygon are not included; Eq. (6) was reproduced at formula level from author-run exports of regional layer means and compared across reduction pathways in 35 pentads; Eq. (7) was recomputed offline from per-pixel exports for all 3,285 pentads (exports withheld; hashes recorded) and differs from the stored series by a quantified seasonal offset; neither equation is described as fully validated. The Phase 7A notebook locks the SHA-256 of a legacy 40-event-annotated pentad table, which is not the canonical 39-event table (see documentation/PHASE7A_INPUT_PROVENANCE.md). The derived data are in a separate Zenodo dataset record.
